newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stena sees traffic boom after tunnel fire.
newsitem.headline: Stena sees traffic boom after tunnel fire.

text.p: Swedish ferry company Stena Line on Tuesday told a Swedish newspaper that it would be carrying traffic comparable to the summer this winter after a fire closed the Channel Tunnel to passenger services.
"We have increased the number of passengers and will switch to a timetable like we have in the summer," Stena Line's spokesman Goran Ekstedt told business daily Finans Tidningen.
He did not say how this would affect Stena Line's results but said there were other advantages.
"It shows how important it is to have a complementary ferry line to the tunnel," said Ekstedt, whose ferry line has been battling against competition from the tunnel since it opened in late 1994.
Eurotunnel SA /Plc on Sunday said the repairs would take at least three months after the fire, which started on board a truck on a freight service last week, seriously damaged the rail system.
